## Hello World

```{term}
echo 'Hello from quarto-term!'
```

## State Persists Across Cells

Define a variable:

```{term}
export NAME="World"
```

Use it later:

```{term}
echo "Hello, $NAME"
```

## Multiple Commands in One Cell

```{term}
for i in 1 2 3; do
  echo "Item $i"
done
```

## Working Directory

```{term}
cd /tmp
pwd
```

```{term}
pwd
```

The session remembers we changed directories.
